This means the cloth now extends almost all the way to the LEFT edge too, underneath the future tray, rather than remaining only on the right. Keep a substantial exposed WOOD BAND across the top (roughly the top 18%) and narrow visible wood margins at left, right, bottom. Cloth edges should be straight, nearly axis aligned, all its corners visible, a very slight natural deviation is fine. Replace the coarse wrinkled linen with thick, substantial, smooth, finely woven cream cotton tablecloth, neatly pressed flat. Soft matte cotton face, dense weave barely visible, gentle fabric body and clean folded stitched hems. NO coarse open weave, burlap, sackcloth, gauze, rough fibers, crumpling, hills or large wrinkles. A very subtle shallow crease is okay, but the work surface should look calm and flat for arranging small paper scraps. Retain the restrained peach flower and muted olive leaf embroidery running close to the lower hem, adapting it naturally to the wider cloth; use a small central flower sprig and slim horizontal embroidered branch extensions. The huge central and upper cloth area is plain cream with no pattern. Preserve the existing chestnut wood grain outside the footprint, overhead 16:9 composition, warm hand-painted storybook game style, upper-left daylight and leaf shadow, ink bottle/twine at top-right and foliage at top edges. Thin soft contact shadow under cloth, no shiny satin. NO red rectangle or annotations, no paper, word slips, tray, text, UI or watermark. Output one full reusable game background.
